enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.hint: Master switch. Off = no events emitted, all commands refused.

botUserId.name: Bot user ID
botUserId.hint: Foundry user id of the AI GM bot account (preferred leader). Set it in Configure AI GM Pirate Borg.

botUserName.name: Bot user name prefix
botUserName.hint: Fallback if no bot user is picked: first GM whose name starts with this. Blank = off.

heartbeatTimeoutMs.name: Leader timeout (ms)
heartbeatTimeoutMs.hint: Default 45000; a human GM takes over only after this.

offlineAfterMs.name: AI GM offline after (ms)
offlineAfterMs.hint: Show AI GM offline when the server has not confirmed the bot for this long (default 60000 ms). Minimum 5000, maximum 600000.

keywords.name: Wake keywords
keywords.hint: Comma-separated words that wake the GM.

hpPath.name: HP data path
hpPath.hint: Actor data path for HP (Pirate Borg: system.attributes.hp.value). Worlds still set to the old system.hp.value path are updated automatically.

alwaysVoiceUsers.name: Always-voice users
alwaysVoiceUsers.hint: Comma-separated user names who always get voice replies.

unpauseOnStart.name: Unpause on 'start'
unpauseOnStart.hint: Typing start in chat unpauses Foundry and wakes the AI GM. Typing pause (GM) pauses the game and stops the AI GM so queued work does not run.

debounceMs.name: Debounce (ms)
debounceMs.hint: Send a chat burst after this much quiet. One bot wake per burst.

maxWaitMs.name: Max wait (ms)
maxWaitMs.hint: Never hold the first event longer than this (default 3500 ms).

wakeOn.name: Wake on
wakeOn.hint: Comma list: mention, whisper, keyword, question, ic (any in-character line).

ignorePlainRolls.name: Ignore plain rolls
ignorePlainRolls.hint: Damage and other non-ability rolls without a question don't wake the bot. Ability tests (d20 / Pirate Borg sheet rolls) still wake it immediately.

ignoreUsers.name: Ignore users
ignoreUsers.hint: Comma list of user names or ids that never wake the bot.

minChars.name: Min characters
minChars.hint: Shorter messages don't wake the bot (mentions and whispers still do).

localCommands.name: Local commands
localCommands.hint: Handle !roll, !music, !scene, !hp, !luck in Foundry with no bot call.

maxTextChars.name: Max text per event
maxTextChars.hint: Longer chat is trimmed in the payload.

ttsMinChars.name: TTS min characters
ttsMinChars.hint: Replies shorter than this are posted as text (no TTS). 0 = off.

uploadsEnabled.name: Allow bot uploads
uploadsEnabled.hint: Let the AI GM upload images, audio and text into the ai-gm-uploads folder. GM-only.

uploadMaxMB.name: Upload size limit (MB)
uploadMaxMB.hint: Largest file the AI GM may upload.

speakerAlias.name: Speaker alias
speakerAlias.hint: Name shown on cards the module posts (roll requests, turn prompts, rest).

rollRequestTimeoutMs.name: Roll request timeout (ms)
rollRequestTimeoutMs.hint: After this, a requested roll shows a GM-only 'roll for them' button and the bot gets a rollTimeout event. The player's Roll button stays available after this timeout, along with a GM fallback.

turnPrompts.name: Combat turn prompts
turnPrompts.hint: Post who is up on each turn change and notify the owning player. Handled in Foundry, no bot wake.

turnWake.name: Wake on NPC/monster turns
turnWake.hint: When on (the default), send a turn event to the bot only when an NPC or monster is up, so fights do not stall. Player-character turns stay local and never wake the bot. Turn this off if you do not want any turn events. A world that already saved this setting off is left off.

turnVoiceUsers.name: Voiced turn prompts for
turnVoiceUsers.hint: Optional allowlist of user names or ids. When blank and Voiced turn prompts is on (the default), every owner hears 'Your turn'. A cached bot clip is used if one exists, else browser speech.

sessionLog.name: Session log
sessionLog.hint: Log HP changes, deaths, items, resources and combat to the GM-only journal 'AI GM Session Log'.

rollRequestExpireMs.name: Roll request expiry after timeout (ms)
rollRequestExpireMs.hint: How long after the timeout a roll card can still be answered (GM fallback window). After that it is marked Expired.

rollAnswerNote.name: Roll answer note
rollAnswerNote.hint: Post a small chat line saying which roll card a roll answered.

ramUsesArmor.name: Ram uses target armour (house rule)
ramUsesArmor.hint: Off (default) matches the Pirate Borg system: a ram rolls the target's armour but does not subtract it. On subtracts the armour roll from ram damage.

thinkingIndicator.name: Show GM status to players
thinkingIndicator.hint: Show every client a small status pill (bottom right, not in chat): waking, reading, thinking, requesting a roll, sending a voice message, speaking, asleep, ready, paused, or offline. The bot can set thinking/voicing with setGmStatus; the rest is automatic. It times out so it never sticks.

thinkingTimeoutMs.name: GM status timeout (ms)
thinkingTimeoutMs.hint: Hide an activity status after this long if nothing else updates it. 0 = only hide when the status is cleared.

combatEvents.name: Send combat start/end
combatEvents.hint: Send the bot an immediate event when combat starts or ends, so it can stay awake during fights.

pushToTalk.name: Push-to-talk (this browser)
pushToTalk.hint: Hold the key or the logo button to speak; your words are posted as your chat message. Drag the button to move it (saved in this browser). Uses your browser's speech recognition (Chrome/Edge).

pushToTalkKey.name: Push-to-talk key
pushToTalkKey.hint: KeyboardEvent code or key, e.g. Backquote, KeyV, F2. Ignored while typing in a text box.

aiPaused.name: Pause the AI GM
aiPaused.hint: When on, player chat is not sent to the AI GM. Use the in-game AI GM panel to pause or resume.

delivery.name: Delivery
delivery.hint: How events reach your bot: relay (recommended; the secret stays in the relay env) or direct (the bot user's browser POSTs to the webhook).

webhookUrl.name: Webhook URL
webhookUrl.hint: Used in direct mode. Leave blank for relay — the relay has its own env-only URL.

botNames.name: Bot names
botNames.hint: Comma-separated names that count as mentioning the GM (for example gm, ai gm).

webhookAuthHeader.name: Webhook auth header
webhookAuthHeader.hint: HTTP header name that carries the webhook secret (default Authorization).

voiceTurnPrompt.name: Voiced turn prompts
voiceTurnPrompt.hint: Say 'Your turn' out loud to the player whose turn it is (browser speech, or a cached clip). No extra bot call. Turn off to keep turn prompts as text and notifications only.

speechHints.name: Speech vocabulary hints
speechHints.hint: Comma-separated combat words used to correct speech-to-text near-misses (for example Kik → kick). Keep this list small.

speechFixes.name: Speech phrase fixes
speechFixes.hint: Comma-separated replacements as heard=intended, for example drop cake=dropkick, kik=kick. Applied before near-miss correction.

ptt.unavailable: Push-to-talk needs a browser with speech recognition (Chrome or Edge). It is turned off here.
ptt.denied: Microphone access was blocked. Allow the mic for this site to use push-to-talk.

status.voicing: GM is sending a voice message…

config.botUser: Bot GM user (preferred leader, runs commands)
config.secretHint: Write-only here. World settings are readable by scripts of any logged-in user, so prefer the relay (env-only secret) for shared worlds.

panel.title: AI GM Pirate Borg
panel.noHp: No tokens with HP on this scene.
panel.clearStuckConfirm: Clear {n} stuck event(s) that were never marked received?
panel.setupOk: All player-looking pirates here have a player owner.
panel.open: Open AI GM Pirate Borg panel
panel.sessionNotes: Plot threads / GM notes (not shown in the recap)
